## Summary

What was found, proposed, decided, or blocked? State one durable piece of information.

## Evidence

Link relevant source files, test results, observations, or the discussion establishing the decision. Separate observations from assumptions.

## Impact

Explain which stories or contracts this affects. Use the optional story field for the originating story and affects for impacted story IDs. Without either, the note applies to the whole slice.

## Next action

State the next step, who should take it, and what resolves the note. For a settled decision, link the updated spec and record who agreed. For superseded notes, link the replacement.
